answer: An ocean of free keys must not earn an ocean of free votes. Before each election, require a hash puzzle bound to the voter key, election ID and an unpredictable beacon. Validators accept each solution once and weight votes by verified work, with no bonus per account. A jade trader splitting into a tide of aliases must repeat the computation; old solutions cannot replay in a new election. This prices influence in compute, not identities. Cheap hardware still gives an advantage, and the energy cost may outweigh the protection.
